notes: The italic *the grapes of* is kept inside the verb's unit as the completion of בָּצַר's lexeme; the alternative treats it as added (rules 7, 44).
The unit heads on *gatherest* rather than on *grapes*, on the same ground as DEU.24.20: *gather* is not a bleached light verb. Heading on *grapes* was the competing reading (rule 8).
*it* in *glean it after thee* is added; no object morpheme stands in the clause (rule 44).
